classes.label: NParks park or nature reserve
classes.summary: Drones are not allowed in this park or nature reserve (NParks).

classes.label: Within 5 km of an aerodrome
classes.summary: Within 5 km of an aerodrome: a no-fly zone for unmanned aircraft without a CAAS permit.
classes.description: Areas within 5km of aerodromes. Conduct of other aerial activities is not allowed unless permit has been obtained from CAAS.

classes.label: Protected area (Air Navigation Act)
classes.summary: Protected area under the Air Navigation Act: a no-fly zone for unmanned aircraft without a CAAS permit.
classes.description: Protected Areas under Air Navigation Act

classes.label: Danger area
classes.summary: Danger area: flying unmanned aircraft is not allowed without a CAAS permit.
classes.description: Flying of unmanned aircraft not allowed unless permit has been obtained from CAAS. Conduct of other aerial activities is not allowed.

classes.label: Restricted area
classes.summary: Restricted area: unauthorised aerial activity is not allowed (see the height limit).

classes.label: Prohibited area
classes.summary: Prohibited area: flying unmanned aircraft is not allowed.
classes.description: Flying of unmanned aircraft is not allowed.  Conduct of other aerial activities is not allowed.

classes.label: UA flying area (open use)
classes.summary: A CAAS unmanned aircraft flying area, where flying is allowed under the area's rules.

classes.label: UA flying area (community-led)
classes.summary: A community-led CAAS unmanned aircraft flying area: contact the club before flying.
